summary: Enter the elegant world of princess Irene and become a royal stylist
description:
Princess Irene and her friends are waiting for you at the castle, join them and discover all the girly things you can do in this stylish princess game. Makeup, hair, dress up, you can do anything you want, the only limit is your creativity!

Irene has an entire makeup salon for herself. Take good care of her skin at the spa and then apply products to create a look worthy of a princess. Use a soft eyeshadow, a sharp liner and finish everything off with mascara and lip gloss. Spend as much time as you wish at the princess makeup salon! 

All girls want to have perfect hair and princess Irene is no exception. You're going to find awesome tools at the hair salon. Try straight hair, soft waves, bouncy curls and other!

You might already know what comes after makeup and hair... it's dress up! Irene has great fashion taste and she owns the most elegant princess dresses in the kingdom. She always wears glamorous clothes paired with precious accessories like tiaras and necklaces. You're going to have a great time playing dress up with her!

Irene is not the only girl in our princess game. You will also meet her lovely BFFs and handsome princes. The princes will need your help to win the girls' hearts. Become a royal stylist and take care of everyone's outfit and appearance. If you love princesses, you'll never get tired of playing Royal Girls - Princess Salon!

Royal Girls - Princess Salon highlights:
- gorgeous princesses and handsome princes
- spa, makeup, hair and multiple dress up levels with unique items
- awesome hair tools (curling irons, hair straighteners, brushes)
- amazing makeup and countless dress up combinations
- free to play, no internet required
- fun and intuitive gameplay

Don't miss out on the fun at the castle with princess Irene and her royal friends. Try one of the most fabulous princess games with makeup, hair and dress up. Enjoy Royal Girls and feel like a real princess!
